propositions: A new blocking check p10_verification_presence must pass leaf plans with a Testing/Verification H2 section, or AC items containing backtick-fenced tokens or matching the verification vocabulary (pytest, test_, make, rebar, git, grep, assert, checked, verif*, exit code)
A new blocking check p11_ac_vagueness uses a fixed lexicon with word boundaries on both sides, excluding 'clean' but retaining 'etc.', scanned over AC item lines only with code-span exemption
Lexicon matches inside recorded inline code spans never fire; 'etc.' within 30 characters after a span's end is exempt using original-line span positions
P6 ac_quality remains advisory and is updated to share the fixed lexicon matcher with P11 for surface consistency
Documentation and existing test posture assertions in test_clarity_floor.py, test_det_floor_operator_attested.py, and test_det_citation.py are updated to reflect P10/P11 blocking rules
